steps.script: mkdir /tmp/made && echo kept > /tmp/made/file && test "$(grep -c kept /tmp/made/file | sed 's/1/one/')" = one

steps.why: Upstream scripts start #!/usr/bin/env, and a file a process writes is executable.
steps.script: printf '#!/usr/bin/env slop\necho by-env\n' > by-env && test "$(./by-env)" = by-env

steps.why: amy is in the image and the index lists cc; no HTTP client is: curl is a package, which brings http@0.
steps.script: ! command -v curl && amy list | grep -q '^cc ' && amy list | grep -q '^curl  *- '

steps.why: The image declares download@0 and upload@0: their commands are in it.
steps.script: download --help | grep -q '^usage: download' && test -x /bin/upload && man download | grep -qi download

steps.why: No compiler, make or Git until a package installs them.
